settings.question: Where do you deliver?
settings.answer: All over Pakistan. We do not ship outside Pakistan.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: We process orders within 24 hours. Delivery takes 3 to 4 working days (Monday to Friday). Remote areas may take longer. Public holidays and bad weather can cause delays.

settings.question: How much is shipping?
settings.answer: Orders under Rs. 6,000 pay Rs. 250. Orders of Rs. 6,000 and above ship free. You see the exact amount at checkout before you pay.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: When your order ships, we send a tracking number by email or WhatsApp.

settings.question: Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
settings.answer: Yes. Pay cash when your parcel arrives. No extra COD fee.

settings.question: Which other payment methods do you accept?
Will you confirm my order?
settings.answer: We may call or WhatsApp you to confirm your order before we send it.

settings.question: Which sizes do you have?
settings.answer: M, L, XL and XXL. See the Size Guide for exact measurements in cm and inches.

settings.question: How do I pick my size?
settings.answer: Measure your best-fitting hoodie laid flat and compare it with our chart, or use "Find my size" on the Size Guide page.

settings.question: Can I exchange my order?
settings.answer: Within 7 days of delivery, for a different size or colour, once per order, if in stock. The item must be unworn, unwashed, with tags on. Sale items cannot be exchanged. You pay the courier charge to send it back; we send the new item. Full rules: Exchange Policy.

settings.question: What if I receive a wrong, damaged or faulty item?
settings.answer: WhatsApp us within 48 hours with clear photos and an unboxing video. We send a replacement and cover the return shipping. See the Exchange Policy.

settings.question: Do you offer refunds?
settings.answer: We do not offer refunds. We help with exchanges and replacements. See the Exchange Policy.
